verses.literal: And Elihu went on to say

verses.original: הֲ֭זֹאת חָשַׁ֣בְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אָ֝מַ֗רְתָּ צִדְקִ֥י מֵאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: Do you think this is just You say I am more righteous than God
verses.literalPt: Tens por direito dizeres: Maior é a minha justiça do que a de Deus?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֹ֭אמַר מַה־ יִּסְכָּן־ לָ֑ךְ מָֽה־ אֹ֝עִ֗יל מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯō·mar mah- yis·kān- lāḵ māh- ’ō·‘îl mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: For you ask What does it profit me and what benefit do I gain apart from sin
verses.literalPt: Porque disseste: De que me serviria? Que proveito tiraria mais do que do meu pecado?

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֣ מִלִּ֑ין וְֽאֶת־ רֵעֶ֥יךָ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.literal: I will reply to you and to your friends as well
verses.literalPt: Eu te darei resposta, a ti e aos teus amigos contigo.

verses.original: הַבֵּ֣ט שָׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וְשׁ֥וּר שְׁ֝חָקִ֗ים גָּבְה֥וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bêṭ šā·ma·yim ū·rə·’êh wə·šūr šə·ḥā·qîm gā·ḇə·hū mim·me·kā
verses.literal: Look to the heavens and see gaze at the clouds high above you
verses.literalPt: Atenta para os céus, e vê; e contempla as mais altas nuvens, que são mais altas do que tu.

verses.original: אִם־ חָ֭טָאתָ מַה־ תִּפְעָל־ בּ֑וֹ וְרַבּ֥וּ פְ֝שָׁעֶ֗יךָ מַה־ תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥā·ṭā·ṯā mah- tip̄·‘āl- bōw wə·rab·bū p̄ə·šā·‘e·ḵā mah- ta·‘ă·śeh- lōw
verses.literal: If you sin what do you accomplish against Him If you multiply your transgressions what do you do to Him
verses.literalPt: Se pecares, que efetuarás contra ele? Se as tuas transgressões se multiplicarem, que lhe farás?

verses.original: אִם־ צָ֭דַקְתָּ מַה־ תִּתֶּן־ ל֑וֹ א֥וֹ מַה־ מִיָּדְךָ֥ יִקָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ṣā·ḏaq·tā mah- tit·ten- lōw ’ōw mah- mî·yā·ḏə·ḵā yiq·qāḥ
verses.literal: If you are righteous what do you give Him or what does He receive from your hand
verses.literalPt: Se fores justo, que lhe darás, ou que receberá ele da tua mão? 8 A tua impiedade faria mal a outro tal como tu; e a tua justiça aproveitaria ao filho do homem.

verses.original: לְאִישׁ־ כָּמ֥וֹךָ רִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וּלְבֶן־ אָ֝דָ֗ם צִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: Your wickedness affects only a man like yourself and your righteousness only a son of man

verses.original: מֵ֭רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִזְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.literal: Men cry out under great oppression they plead for relief from the arm of the mighty
verses.literalPt: Por causa das muitas opressões os homens clamam por causa do braço dos grandes.

verses.original: וְֽלֹא־ אָמַ֗ר אַ֭יֵּה אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֹשָׂ֑י נֹתֵ֖ן זְמִר֣וֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.literal: But no one asks Where is God my Maker who gives us songs in the night
verses.literalPt: Porém ninguém diz: Onde está Deus que me criou, que dá salmos durante a noite;

verses.original: מַ֭לְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמ֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ׃
verses.literal: who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the air
verses.literalPt: Que nos ensina mais do que aos animais da terra e nos faz mais sábios do que as aves dos céus?

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם יִ֭צְעֲקוּ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י גְּא֣וֹן רָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šām yiṣ·‘ă·qū wə·lō ya·‘ă·neh mip·pə·nê gə·’ō·wn rā·‘îm
verses.literal: There they cry out but He does not answer because of the pride of evil men
verses.literalPt: Clamam, porém ele não responde, por causa da arrogância dos maus.

verses.original: אַךְ־ שָׁ֭וְא לֹא־ יִשְׁמַ֥ע׀ אֵ֑ל וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḵō·šā- šā·wəʾ lō- yiš·ma‘ ’êl wə·šad·day lō yə·šū·ren·nāh
verses.literal: Surely God does not listen to empty pleas and the Almighty does not take note of it
verses.literalPt: Certo é que Deus não ouvirá a vaidade, nem atentará para ela o Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: אַ֣ף כִּֽי־ תֹ֭אמַר לֹ֣א תְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ דִּ֥ין לְ֝פָנָ֗יו וּתְח֥וֹלֵֽל לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ kî- ṯō·mar lō ṯə·šū·ren·nū dîn lə·p̄ā·nāw ū·ṯə·ḥō·w·lêl lōw
verses.literal: How much less then, when you say that you do not see Him that your case is before Him and you must wait for Him
verses.literalPt: E quanto ao que disseste, que o não verás, juízo há perante ele; por isso espera nele.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּי־ אַ֭יִן פָּקַ֣ד אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֖ע בַּפַּ֣שׁ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kî- ’a·yin pā·qaḏ ’ap·pōw wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ bap·paš mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: and further that in His anger He has not punished or taken much notice . . . of folly
verses.literalPt: Mas agora, porque a sua ira ainda não se exerce, nem grandemente considera a arrogância,

verses.original: וְ֭אִיּוֹב הֶ֣בֶל יִפְצֶה־ פִּ֑יהוּ בִּבְלִי־ דַ֝֗עַת מִלִּ֥ין יַכְבִּֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’î·yō·wḇ he·ḇel yip̄·ṣeh- pî·hū biḇ·lî- ḏa·‘aṯ mil·lîn yaḵ·bir
verses.literal: So Job opens his mouth in vain and multiplies words without knowledge
verses.literalPt: Logo Jó em vão abre a sua boca, e sem ciência multiplica palavras.
